library.meta_desc.en: Every PDF from AA Grapevine and La Viña plus NETA 65 committee documents — GVR and RLV kits, catalogs, flyers, order forms and reports. Searchable in English and Spanish, updated automatically every day.

library.how_title.en: How this library keeps itself up to date
library.how_title.es: Cómo se mantiene al día esta biblioteca

library.how_crawl.en: Every day a polite robot reads aagrapevine.org and aalavina.org page by page and records every PDF — new flyers, order forms and news sheets show up on their own.
library.how_crawl.es: Cada día un robot respetuoso recorre aagrapevine.org y aalavina.org página por página y registra cada PDF — los volantes, formularios y hojas de noticias nuevos aparecen solos.

library.how_crawl_progress.en: So far the robot has checked {crawled} of the {known} pages it knows about — it picks up where it left off each day.
library.how_crawl_progress.es: Hasta ahora el robot ha revisado {crawled} de las {known} páginas que conoce — cada día continúa donde se quedó.

library.how_drive.en: Reports, notes, slides and workshop files the committee saves to its shared Google Drive folder are added automatically.
library.how_drive.es: Los informes, notas, presentaciones y archivos de talleres que el comité guarda en su carpeta compartida de Google Drive se agregan automáticamente.

library.how_lang.en: Titles are translated automatically, so you can search in either language. The documents themselves stay in their original language.
library.how_lang.es: Los títulos se traducen automáticamente, así que puedes buscar en cualquiera de los dos idiomas. Los documentos se quedan en su idioma original.

library.ask.en: Looking for something that isn't here? Write to the committee and we'll help you find it.
